name: Tm Visualization Suite: Spatial Explorer
pitch: Group locations into H3 areas and color each area by its value on a map.
question: Where are the values, and how do they differ between areas of the map?
useWhen: Map values when each row has a latitude and a longitude.
features: Group locations into H3 hexagon areas at a resolution from 0 to 15.
Color each area by the value of the observations in it.
Show a bundled country outline with no network request.
Add your own tile service as a background map with your attribution text.
Select every observation in an area with one click.
Pan and zoom the map without a change to the Qlik selection.

hero.alt: H3 hexagon map of delivery points in Norway, Sweden, and Denmark, with darker areas for higher value.
